arch_baselines_used._README: Hand-curated standard (vanilla, non-adversarial) top-1 accuracy of canonical architectures on the benchmark training set only (NO extra/pretraining data), to support the 'architecture-matched' comparison reference.
arch_baselines_used._datasets_per_entry: std_acc is top-1 % on the standard test set. If 'per_dataset' is present, the dataset-specific value overrides std_acc for that dataset (used by scripts/scrape_benchmarks.py match_arch).
arch_baselines_used._verified_flag: 'verified' is a per-dataset map {dataset: bool}. true = number taken from a fetched primary source (torchvision model zoo or the cited paper). false = drafted from cited paper memory / approximated from a nearest config and NOT yet verified — review before relying. The dataset key matches entries in 'datasets' / 'per_dataset'.
arch_baselines_used._torchvision_choice: For ImageNet, torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1 weights (original published recipe) are used. V2 (2022 improved-recipe) weights exist for most and are higher but use heavier augmentation / longer training, so V1 is treated as the canonical 'vanilla' number. Where only a V2 (or only SWAG/extra-data) weight exists this is noted in the source field.
